soldier: Head yellow, mandibles purplish brown, pilosity of the head capsule sparse. Head capsule rectangular, head-width index 0.55–0.62, lateral margins parallel, posterior margin nearly straight. Frontal region flat, only slightly depressed behind the frons. Labrum lanceolate, the apex passing from narrowly rounded to pointedly rounded; labral setae well developed, apical, subapical and lateral apical setae all rather long. Mandibular apex rather strongly curved; length 0.49–0.52 of head capsule length and 0.85–0.90 of head width. Antennae 16–17 segments. Broad region of the postmentum at the anterior fifth, anterior lateral margins trapezoidal, the middle section shallowly concave; waist region slightly broad with parallel margins, waist constriction index 0.36–0.49. Pronotum kidney-shaped, about 1.63–1.72 times as wide as long, the incisions at the middle of the anterior and posterior margins both rather distinct; about 20 setae in the middle region.
taxonomy_note: The letters of the genus name are defective in the original work, printed as Reticuliter mes; this is in fact Reticulitermes, the same genus name as used on this site.
